sources.prompt:
The first attached image is our own code-drawn sprite sheet of a market trader of the city halls, a background character of a night harbour city where people duel with cards. The second attached image is the approved pixel-art sprite sheet of the player character of the same game. Redraw the character of the first image as a final sprite sheet in exactly the style, pixel size, proportions, figure height and cell layout of the second image, so that both characters stand side by side in the same scene.

Each cell is 64 art pixels wide and 96 art pixels tall; the character is about 88 art pixels tall and fills the cell height like the character of the second image (top of the head near the top of the cell, feet near the bottom). Stylised RPG proportions like the player: sturdy, about 3 heads tall; large readable hands.

Exact grid of 5 columns and 3 rows of equal cells, nothing between the cells; row 1 facing the viewer, row 2 seen from the back, row 3 right profile walking to the right; column 1 standing still, columns 2 to 5 a clear four-frame walking cycle (legs alternating, arms swinging, head steady); same size in every cell, both feet fully visible and on the same baseline, figure centred.

Premium illustrative pixel art exactly like the second attached image: crisp square pixels of one uniform size across the whole sheet; colour ramps of four to five tones per material; a continuous very dark (near black) outline around the whole silhouette, never a light or white outline; soft directional shading with readable fabric folds; clean pixel clusters, no dithering, no scattered noise, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. The face stays fully visible, with clearly drawn eyes, a small mouth and a hint of nose shading.

The character: an adult woman, warm and lively; hair tied up in a bun; a long coat reaching below the knees with a knitted shawl crossed over the chest, a blouse, dark trousers, sturdy boots; no hat, no bag, nothing in the hands.

Placeholder colours for in-game recolouring, each in flat shades of one pure hue only: skin (face, ears, neck, hands) in shades of pure red only (from #400000 to #FF0000); hair and eyebrows in shades of pure yellow only (from #404000 to #FFFF00); the long coat in shades of pure magenta only (from #400040 to #FF00FF); the blouse in shades of pure cyan only (from #004040 to #00FFFF). Everything else in dark, desaturated natural greys and browns: the shawl dark grey-brown, trousers dark grey, boots dark grey-brown, eyes very dark brown with a white catchlight, mouth dark. A dark outline separates every placeholder-coloured area from any other colour. No other red, yellow, magenta, cyan, green or blue anywhere.

A perfectly flat, uniform pure blue (#0000FF) background with no shading, no texture, no floor and no cast shadow.

No text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no labels, no watermark, no logos, no playing-card suit symbols.

etapes: fond bleu et liseré teinté retirés ; alpha binaire
pas des pixels d’art mesuré sur les arêtes (3.37 × 2.985 px)
figures repérées par les bandes vides ; grille d’art 64 × 96 px d’art par case imposée, couleur majoritaire du cœur de chaque bloc
pieds alignés sur une même ligne, tête centrée
tons clés (peau, cheveux, tenue, chemise) ramenés exactement sur 64, 128, 191, 255

yeux (passe 138) : de face, les deux yeux du brut recalés (tels quels ou en miroir) et moyennés en un seul dessin, échantillonné à la phase qui le rend le mieux et posé aux deux places après la palette ; aucun ton clé de vêtement ni d’accent dans les yeux et les sourcils (face et profil)
